from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(description="Full name of the party (person or entity) as written in the document")
    role: str = Field(description="Role of the party in this legal proceeding (e.g., Appellant, Respondent, Applicant)")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    amount: float = Field(description="The specific amount of the fee or fine in numeric form")
    currency: str = Field(default="RMB", description="Currency, typically RMB/CNY for Chinese legal documents")
    type: str = Field(description="Category of the fee (e.g., Second Instance Litigation Fee, Execution Fee, Fine)")
    bearer: str = Field(description="Who is responsible for paying this fee")

class CaseNumber(BaseModel):
    number: str = Field(description="Official case number (e.g., （2023）辽 01 执恢 293 号)")
    stage: str = Field(description="Stage or type associated with the number (e.g., First Instance, Retrial, Execution)")

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    document_type: str = Field(description="Type of legal document (e.g., Civil Second Instance Judgment, Administrative Retrial Ruling)")
    court: str = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the document")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="List of fees, costs, or fines mentioned")
    case_numbers: list[CaseNumber] = Field(description="List of all case numbers referenced")
    outcome_summary: str = Field(description="High-level summary of the ruling outcome (e.g., Dismiss Appeal, Revoke)")
    specific_orders: list[str] = Field(description="Specific court orders or decrees (e.g., Revoke Item 1, Pay Amount X)")
    jurisdiction_info: str = Field(description="Relevant jurisdiction information if specified (e.g., 'Wuhan Railway Court')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[DocumentCase] = Field(description="Extracted case details from the current document")
